initial_prompt:
Revise the FIRST attached Turkish appointment management UI draft into a much more thoughtfully composed, visually rich and finished PRODUCT UI. The user has approved its functional concept of grouping a day's appointments by employee but rejected its plain, cheap-looking execution. The SECOND image is the REAL existing application's design authority for shell, typography, palette, controls and scale. Create ONE full-fidelity revised DESKTOP screen, landscape 1440 by 1000 approximately, app edge-to-edge, no browser chrome or device frame.

Keep the first image's JOB and two-employee grouped chronological structure, but materially elevate the central appointments workspace. Keep the second image's exact brand identity: white header about 80 high, white 240-wide left sidebar, near-white #FAFBFD canvas, white #FFFFFF surface, dark ink #253044, muted blue #4C72AD primary action, slate navy #405775 secondary action; pale blue and navy tints derived only from these colors. Flat restrained 6px corners, hairline separators, NO shadows, NO gradients, NO green/amber, NO photos, avatars or invented icons with colored circles. The brand word Randevu is the existing Unna-like serif. Every task heading and UI label uses the existing capable SYSTEM SANS. This remains the same app, not a new SaaS brand.

Preserve the REAL shell from image two, not image one's approximated shell: Randevu at left; top-right 'Örnek işletme · İşletme Sahibi' followed by the explicit filled navy 'Çıkış yap' button, no account dropdown. Sidebar shows Yönetim, selected Randevular, İşletme group with İşletme bilgileri / İşletme saatleri / Hizmetler / Rezervasyon ayarları; Ekip group Personel / Çalışan erişimleri; Hesap group Hesap ve güvenlik; Değişiklik kayıtları below a separator. Tiny coherent line icons only where the reference has navigation icons. Do not redesign the shell.

MAIN WORKSPACE: generous 32px page inset. Header line: strong dark system-sans 'Randevular' at left and flat muted-blue 'Yeni randevu' button at right, with a small honest navy note 'Örnek kayıtlar · Görsel taslak' underneath the title. Day toolbar is a clean horizontal white band with slender separators and precise baseline alignment: at left two 44px navy previous/next buttons; middle-left date '16 Ekim 2026' bold with 'Cuma' as quiet supporting text, then filled navy 'Bugün' button; far right visible label 'Çalışan' and native-looking outlined select 'Tümü'. No stats dashboard, search box, week/month switches, status-filter controls or unsupported features.

BELOW: two staff schedule sections of equal WIDTH, natural CONTENT height. The key visual gesture is each staff's composed editorial schedule header: pale blue full-width header band, strong left-aligned 'Personel A' or 'Personel B', a small line underneath 'Günlük randevular', and a single fine bottom rule. No number badges and no fictitious totals. Under it a precise TIMELINE of actual appointment rows. A narrow TIME RAIL on the left: large bold tabular start time e.g. 09.00, smaller end time beneath, a tiny blue point on a thin vertical navy-tint chronological connector at its right. The connector ends with the content, NOT full-day empty grid. Appointment content to the right has a bold readable customer label, muted service on the next line, a quiet typographic status marker placed with careful alignment, and a compact 'Ayrıntılar' text-link with a small right-arrow at the lower right. Use negative space, restrained light-blue row surface treatment and refined alignment to give the rows visual substance. Prefer one continuous schedule surface with thin separators over cards inside cards. Both employee sections align at top but STOP after their own last row, leaving calm canvas underneath. Never stretch either section to viewport bottom. The first image's huge blank bordered columns are specifically REJECTED. Do not duplicate staff names on every appointment when already under their staff heading.

Exact synthetic content, no additional records:
Personel A: 09.00 to 09.30, Müşteri 01, Saç kesimi, Onaylı.
Personel A: 10.30 to 10.55, Müşteri 02, Saç kesimi, Onay bekliyor.
Personel B: 09.15 to 10.00, Müşteri 03, Saç ve sakal, Onaylı.
Onaylı status is navy on a very pale blue tint, Onay bekliyor is navy with a restrained fine outline; words carry meaning. No status colors from a different palette. One single Ayrıntılar action per record. No fake available time slots, now marker, revenue, counts, staff capacity, portrait, ratings or client phone number. No unused widgets to fill the canvas.

The result must show a noticeable improvement in layout craft, rhythm and information hierarchy over the first input, while visibly belonging to the app in the second input. It should read like a finished practical salon work tool: easy to scan, well-categorized by employee, substantial rather than empty, calm rather than decorative. Controls and body text readable near 16px, 44px action targets. This is a labeled synthetic design preview, NOT evidence of a live functional screen. Return ONLY the revised flat desktop UI image.
